title: Oliver Owl's Night Light
description: A comforting tale about a young owl who learns to see the beauty in nighttime shadows.

scenes.narration: High in a tall pine tree, little Oliver Owl was supposed to love the dark, but shadows made him nervous.
scenes.visual: cute baby owl sitting on a tree branch looking timidly at the dusk sky

scenes.narration: When the sun went down, the forest turned dark and mysterious, making Oliver snuggle deeper into his nest.
scenes.visual: dark blue evening forest with soft shadows and glowing blue atmospheric mist

scenes.narration: Suddenly, a small yellow light flickered near his beak. It was a tiny firefly floating on the breeze.
scenes.visual: glowing yellow firefly fluttering right in front of a wide eyed baby owl

scenes.narration: More fireflies joined in, dancing together like tiny floating stars across the quiet forest night.
scenes.visual: dozens of sparkling fireflies lighting up the dark green branches of a forest tree

scenes.narration: Oliver realized the night was full of gentle glowing lights if he just remembered where to look.
scenes.visual: happy little owl watching tiny lights twinkle around his tree branch

scenes.narration: He spread his wings and took a brave, peaceful glide through the warm lantern glow of the woods.
scenes.visual: baby owl gliding gracefully through the night sky surrounded by floating golden sparks

scenes.narration: The dark is full of friendly starlight. Rest well little owl, and follow along for more bedtime adventures.
scenes.visual: little owl tucked comfortably in a cozy nest sleeping under a starry moonlit sky

character_reference: A small, fluffy young owl with soft hazel-brown and cream speckled feathers, featuring large round golden-yellow eyes, a tiny curved pale beak, and subtle white feather markings around its face.
